THE GAZETTE TO AMEND THE EXTRAORDINARY GAZETTE NOTIFICATION OF THEDEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA BEARING No. 2133/4 DATED 22ND JULY, 2019

I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Development by virtue of the powers vested in meunder the Urban Development Authority Law do hereby amend the Gazette Notification bearing No. 2133/4 dated 22ndJuly, 2019 by inserting immediately after the list of appointees thereof, the following subsections to have a uniformeffect as the principle Gazette Notification :

1. The Advisory Committee shall be empowered to perform and discharge all duties and functions pertaining toadvising the Minister on the given subject and those incidental thereto as given hereunder by exercising duediligence ;
(a) Carrying out comprehensive inquiries on the demands for housing facilities with special needs
(b) Providing appropriate recommendations as and when required

(c) Entertaining requisitions made by applicants under the Urban Regeneration Project, implemented by theUrban Development Authority under the umbrella of the Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development
2. It shall be the duty of the Advisory Committee to tender advice on the future direction and strategy to the Ministerand make its recommendations thereon.

3. The Minister may give special or general directions in writing as to the performance of the duties and the exerciseof the powers of the Advisory Committee and the Advisory Committee shall give effect to such directions.

4. The term of office of the members of the Advisory Committee shall be initially from 1st July 2019 to 1st July2020 subject to an extension for a further term contingent on the work performance.
5. A member vacating his office by resignation or by the expiration of his term of his office shall be eligible for re-appointment.
6. (a) Any member of the Advisory Committee may resign from office by letter to that effect addressed to theMinister.

(b) Where a member is temporary unable to discharge the duties of his office on account of ill health, absencefrom Sri Lanka or any other cause, the Minister may appoint some other person to act as a member in hisplace for the period of his absence.
7. The members of the Advisory Committee and other officers and servants may be paid such remuneration out of thefund as may be determined by the Authority.
8. The Advisory Committee may with the approval of the Minister, appoint such officers or servants to assist theAdvisory Committee in carrying out its duties under this mandate.

9. Notwithstanding the provisions contained in the antecedent Gazette Notification bearing No. 2133/4 dated 22ndJuly, 2019, the newly incorporated subsections hereinbefore mentioned shall be deemed to have come into operationon the 22nd day of July, 2019.
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (M. P.),Minister of Megapolis and Western Development.
